name: Lawful Good
description: Acts with honor and compassion, following rules to do what is right.

name: Neutral Good
description: Does the best they can to help others, without strict adherence to rules.

name: Chaotic Good
description: Follows their heart, valuing freedom and kindness over laws.

name: Lawful Neutral
description: Follows rules and order above all else, regardless of morality.

name: True Neutral
description: Maintains balance, avoiding extremes of good or evil.

name: Chaotic Neutral
description: Values personal freedom and unpredictability above all.

name: Lawful Evil
description: Uses rules and structure to achieve selfish or harmful goals.

name: Neutral Evil
description: Acts in self-interest, without concern for order or chaos.

name: Chaotic Evil
description: Driven by destruction and chaos, with no regard for others.
